scope: All currently accepted fork/clone/vfork combinations: creator-mm custody, live queue admission/retirement, original family/namespace/cgroup birth transaction, retained guarded fork storage and live record-lock PID translation.

concurrency.construction: Original Rc owner performs scoped construction while creator-mm actors return. Unrelated address spaces keep running. Existing shared resources retain object locks; original workers accept newborn jobs.

remaining_boundaries: Task/VFS Rc construction still occurs on its existing owner at creator-mm custody
Exec, tracing, non-ALLOW policy and namespace administration retain joined entry
Mixed true mapping requests keep backing closure and external-borrow boundary
Actual excluded backing/native/supervision controls retain their explicit boundaries; solo caller path remains

benchmark.scope: 128 two-thread groups: fork/clone, leader exit, final-thread exit and parent wait, alternating ordinary files and private epoll controls. Two untimed warmups per binary/CPU count, then seven counterbalanced pairs per CPU count. Includes structural fork/mm work; not a general CPU or Firefox benchmark. Vfork uses the same prior fixture. Local Linux test instance was stopped and no build ran during timings.

candidate_metadata_note: The measured isolated binary embeds the old c05a7e9 runtime label because pins were unchanged before committing. Its tested source files match runtime_revision exactly; the final Dev package is rebuilt with the committed pin.

negative_controls.retained_fork_journal: Restoring unconditional parent snapshot invalidation loses a late backing write: 7 instead of 9; patched test passes.
negative_controls.parked_cpu_reservation: Restoring a parked task initial CPU reservation times out while an unrelated peer occupies that CPU; patched test resumes on another executor.
